title: BUFFALO: PPA-Configurable, LLM-based Buffer Tree Generation via Group Relative Policy Optimization
problem: Buffer insertion optimization requires balancing trade-offs between Power, Performance, and Area but local heuristics don't scale to achieve globally optimal solutions.
motivation: Traditional buffering methods are suboptimal; prior ML approaches are prohibitively slow due to incremental nature.
method: Generative buffer insertion framework using LLM for single-shot buffer tree generation on all violating nets, refined with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) RL technique for PPA-configurable solution quality.
key_novelty: First formulation of buffer tree generation as sequence-to-sequence task solved by LLMs in physical design.
limitations: Evaluation limited to 9 full-chip designs at 7nm node; generalization to other technology nodes unclear.
primary_theme: LLM-based buffer insertion with GRPO optimization
